title: Structured bid.native OBJECT markup carrier instead of a JSON adm string

source.name: Documented structured bid.native SSP convention (this repo's own Inspector contract)
source.notes: Field composition follows IAB Native 1.2 §5.1 Native Markup Response; the carrier location (bid.native object instead of bid.adm string) is a documented non-IAB SSP convention, not an IAB-standard Bid attribute — see specNotes.

modifications: All auction, bid, creative, site and publisher identifiers are synthetic.
All domains use reserved .test names; no real user IDs, IP addresses, consent strings or tracker endpoints.
Images are a minimal original 1x1 PNG data: URI; no public creative copied.
device.ip is the documentation-only address 192.0.2.11; OS values describe a synthetic test device.
provenance.sanitized: Only synthetic identifiers, original fixture creatives, reserved domains and TEST-NET addresses. No live tokens, subscriber IDs or real tracking URLs.

pairApplicability.note: The bid still references an offered impression and clears its floor; only the markup carrier field differs from the IAB-standard bid.adm string.

title.text: A tidy workspace kit for small rooms

specNotes: Protocol validity is based on cited fields, not on current Core output. Optional-field warnings do not make this pair invalid.

OpenRTB 2.6 §4.2.3 Object: Bid has no `native` attribute of its own — the only standard markup carrier is `adm` (string; §4.2.3). `bid.native` as a structured object is a documented, non-IAB SSP convention: public/ortbtools.app.js:4026-4034 and specs/014-push-creative-preview/{spec,plan}.md treat it as a first-class, deliberately implemented shape ('structured bid.native (oRTB 2.6+) wins over findAdm's recursive walk'). This bid carries no adm and no nurl at all — bid.native is its only markup.
Field composition (asset ids/types/required flags/lengths) still follows IAB Native 1.2 §5.1 Native Markup Response exactly; only the carrier location differs from the IAB-standard bid.adm string.
Browser assertions are proposed observables; this corpus has not been run in a browser for this case.
Do not infer rendering from analysis.status or iframe existence alone.

Images are minimal 1x1 data: PNGs so the browser layer can prove imgLoaded without any network fetch or CSP interaction; the declared w/h asset metadata (64x64 icon, 300x157 main) drive the Inspector's icon/hero heuristic independently of the actual decoded pixel size.

Known direct-Core observation: rules-response.js's markup-presence check (`!isStr(b.adm) && !isStr(b.nurl)`) and crosscheck.js's native crossmatch gate (`imp.native && bid.adm`) both key off bid.adm only, so this valid bid is flagged with a false-positive response.bid.payload_missing warning and never receives a crosscheck.bid.native_complete verdict. See knownGap DEF-150.
Inspect intended click target without following it.
notes: Core observations in the source archive were deliberately excluded from expectations. Protocol metadata may describe a vendor-specific 2.x carrier; it does not claim a normative minor-version inference.
